text: When the cupboard was opened, a loose shelf tipped forward, causing three folders to fall. No items were damaged, and no injuries were reported. The remaining folders were removed from the cupboard and placed on a table to prevent further falls. A note was left on the cupboard to warn others not to use it until the shelf could be inspected and secured. The incident was contained without additional damage, and the area was left in a safer condition.
